data.name: The Witch's Wilds
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

An older sister and her younger brother have been taken by a mysterious witch to a strange and eerie wilderness.

There are no familiar roads here, and no one they can rely on.

To survive, they must explore the wilderness, search for food and water, gather useful materials, and gradually craft more practical tools.

You can switch between the brother and sister as the lead character, guiding them as they explore the environment and struggle to survive.

Explore the Eerie Wilderness

Lead the siblings through this unfamiliar wilderness.

Search for edible fruits and mushrooms, gather materials scattered throughout the environment, and stay alert for dangers lurking nearby.

What secrets does this wilderness hold?

Why did the witch bring them here?

Perhaps, as you explore, you'll gradually uncover the answers.

Survive

Both siblings must manage their health, hunger, and thirst.

  • Find food

  • Obtain water

  • Gather resources from the wilderness

  • Manage both characters' survival needs

  • Make difficult choices with limited resources

Gathering & Crafting

Many things in the wilderness can become essential resources for survival.

Explore your surroundings, gather resources, and craft useful items to unlock more tools, equipment, and ways to survive.

Game Features

  • Two-Character Survival

  • Explore the Wilderness

  • Gathering & Resource Management

  • Cooking & Crafting

  • Pixel-Art Adventure

data.short_description: A pixel-art survival crafting game. An older sister and her younger brother are taken by a witch to a strange and eerie wilderness. Switch between the two as you explore, gather, cook, and craft while managing their health, hunger, and thirst—and do whatever it takes to survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 8.1 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo (or equivalent AMD processor)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics, supporting DirectX 9.0c
  • Sound Card: Any DirectSound compatible sound card
